title: 第九十九章突然变强的神识第九十八章谁也没得罪
content_zh:
第九十九章，突然变强的神识！！！
婺城，城主府。
赵赟，黄满山以及张北田三人再次齐聚一堂，只是脸上神情不像先前那般洋洋得意，而是十分难看，就像啃了一坨狗屎。
“可恶！”
“这都能让吴家起死回生么？？”
“明明就差一步，就差那么一步啊！！”
“该死的秦风，坏我们好事。”
“实在是罪该万死！！”
黄满山咬牙切齿道。
他布局多年，不惜花费巨大代价，为自己儿子弄了一个学院名额，眼看果实累累，即将迎来丰收时，却突然变故，被秦风所破坏，岂能不狠？
张北田也叹气道：“谁也没想到会这样子啊，那秦风简直就是妖孽，连龙家八大长老都能击杀不说，甚至还敢拒绝那么多家族势力，皇子使者们的见面，实在是令人难以捉摸。”
“吴熵这是走了什么狗屎运？居然能让他遇到秦风！！”
“诶！！”
赵赟闻言二人的话，倒是气定神闲道：“不要着急，秦风总有离开的时候，莫非你们真以为，吴家就能因此翻身？？”
“也未免太小看我们自己了吧？”
“若不是有秦风在吴府里待在，谁会把吴熵当回事呢？”
“再说了。”
“龙家这次损失惨重，虽然暂时没有动作，可不代表真的没有。”
“龙战是什么样的人，你们还不清楚么？？”
听到这番话的二人，彼此对视一眼后，立马眼前一亮。

黄满山急忙问道：“是不是龙战和你透过什么气了？快说来听听。”
“是啊，城主。”
“只要龙家还想出手，区区吴家自然不足为惧。”
张北田也急忙说道。
然而赵赟却摇头道：“想什么呢？龙战岂会什么事情都告诉老夫？”
“眼下最主要的就是等。”
“等一个机会就行。”
“你们这些日子，千万不要再和吴家起冲突了。”
“而且，一个月后，秦风就会离开婺城。”
“到时候，才是龙家出手的最好机会！！”
此言一出，黄满山和张北田顿时明白了什么，随后便发出了阴冷笑声。
可在赵赟看来，无论是黄满山也好，还是张北田也好，都只是自己手里的一枚棋子罢了，想要争夺自己的城主之位，哪有那么容易。
content_en:
Chapter ninety-nine, a suddenly stronger consciousness! ! !
Wucheng, the city lord's mansion.
Zhao Yun, Huang Manshan and Zhang Beitian gathered together again, but their faces were not as proud as before, but looked very ugly, as if they had eaten a piece of dog shit.
"Damn it!"
"Can this bring the Wu family back to life??"
"It's obviously just one step away, just that one step away!!"
"Damn Qin Feng, ruined our good deeds."
“It’s really a crime worthy of death!!”
Huang Manshan gritted his teeth and said.
He had been planning for many years and spent a lot of money to get a place in the academy for his son. Seeing the fruits were abundant and about to usher in a good harvest, something suddenly happened and was destroyed by Qin Feng. How could he not be cruel?
Zhang Beitian also sighed and said: "No one expected it to be like this. That Qin Feng is simply a monster. He can kill even the eight elders of the Long family, and he even dares to reject so many family forces. The meeting of the prince's envoys is really unpredictable."
"What kind of bad luck did Wu Entropy have? He was actually allowed to meet Qin Feng!!"
"Hey!!"
When Zhao Yun heard what the two of them said, he said calmly: "Don't be anxious, Qin Feng will always leave. Do you really think that the Wu family can turn around because of this?"
"Aren't we underestimating ourselves too much?"
"If Qin Feng hadn't stayed in Wu Mansion, who would have taken Wu Entropy seriously?"
"Say no more."
"The Long family has suffered heavy losses this time. Although there is no action for the time being, it does not mean that there is really nothing."
"Don't you still know what kind of person Long Zhan is??"
After hearing these words, the two people looked at each other and their eyes immediately lit up.
Huang Manshan asked hurriedly: "Did Long Zhan and you get angry? Come on, tell me."
"Yes, City Lord."
"As long as the Long family still wants to take action, the Wu family will naturally have nothing to fear."
Zhang Beitian also said hurriedly.
However, Zhao Yun shook his head and said, "What are you thinking about? How could Long Zhan tell me everything?"
"The most important thing right now is to wait."
"Just wait for an opportunity."
"You must not conflict with the Wu family again these days."
"Moreover, Qin Feng will leave Wucheng in one month."
"That's when the Long family has the best opportunity to take action!!"
As soon as these words came out, Huang Manshan and Zhang Beitian immediately understood something, and then they laughed coldly.
But in Zhao Yun's view, whether it is Huang Manshan or Zhang Beitian, they are just pawns in his hands. It is not that easy to compete for his position as city lord.
